newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti needs simpler structure -- Caio.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti needs simpler structure -- Caio.

text.p: Italy's Olivetti needs a simpler group structure and must rethink the role of the holding company, according to the group's chief executive Francesco Caio.

Giving a testimony to the upper house Senate industry commission he said, "We are heading towards simplifying the activities of Olivetti, a group which does not need the complex management structure which we have at present.
"We will have to rethink the role of the holding company which must become much more one of strategic control," he added.
